Title: Default Title Qty Add to Cart Description Perhaps the flagship pedal of KHDK Electronics, this is the Ghoul Screamer an overdrive loaded with tweaks and mods to give you one of the most versatile overdrive boxes weve come across in a long time. The five switches control the essential components of your sound: EQ, dynamics and pick sensitivity. Proudly built and hand-tested in Kentucky and complete with haunting artwork by San Franciscos tattoo wizard Tim Lehi Peters. With all switches up, the pedal acts as the classic Tubescreamer but once you start tweaking, youll find you can dial this pedal in to complement your setup and playing style perfectly.
